title: The drift coordinate of the embedded sphere equation
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: The drift coordinate of the embedded sphere equation. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: For an ambient field $u$ and a real temperature function $\lambda$, the drift at a unit vector is the negative field plus the radial correction. The definition returns its $i$th coordinate.
